note: WBM actions replaces core's node publish/unpublish bulk actions with one bulk action per Workbench Moderation state. It defines a single core Action plugin id 'state_change' with StateChangeDeriver, whose derivatives are keyed <entity_type>__<state_id> (e.g. node__archived, block_content__draft). hook_install creates one 'action' config entity per derivative (id state_change__<type>__<state>, plugin state_change:<type>__<state>, type = entity type id). Its persistent, verifiable state is therefore these 'action' config entities. Medium/hard cases create/read/delete those Action config entities (router-safe, no serialization). Requires Workbench Moderation (contrib), NOT core Content Moderation. NOTE: on this shared site the actions were not auto-created at install time, and creating bundles/roles or serializing entities fatals, so evals stick to Action config entities.

evals.prompt: What does the workbench_moderation_actions (WBM actions) module do to the bulk Action dropdown on /admin/content, and which core actions does it replace?
evals.expected_output: On install it deletes core's node_publish_action and node_unpublish_action and creates one bulk action per Workbench Moderation state (the state_change action plugin, derived per entity type x state), so editors can 'Set <Entity> as <State>' for many nodes at once.

evals.prompt: In workbench_moderation_actions, what is the Action plugin id and how are its derivatives named for, say, setting nodes to the 'archived' state?
evals.expected_output: The Action plugin id is 'state_change' with StateChangeDeriver; derivatives are keyed <entity_type_id>__<state_id>, so the node->archived derivative is state_change:node__archived (its action config entity id is state_change__node__archived).

evals.prompt: Which moderation system does workbench_moderation_actions require, and what happens to the core publish/unpublish actions if I later uninstall it?
evals.expected_output: It requires the contrib Workbench Moderation module (not core Content Moderation). hook_uninstall restores node_publish_action and node_unpublish_action from the node module's default config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a workbench_moderation_actions bulk action config entity with id state_change__node__archived. Inspect the live action and state which moderation state it sets content to.
evals.expected_output: It sets nodes to the 'archived' moderation state - the action's plugin is state_change:node__archived (the derivative key <entity_type>__<state> encodes node + archived).

evals.prompt: A workbench_moderation_actions state_change action exists on this site whose id is state_change__block_content__draft. Inspect it and state which entity type it applies to and which moderation state it sets.
evals.expected_output: It applies to the block_content (custom block) entity type and sets the 'draft' moderation state: type = block_content, plugin = state_change:block_content__draft.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create the workbench_moderation_actions bulk action that sets NODES to the 'needs_review' moderation state, so it appears in the Action dropdown on /admin/content. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an 'action' config entity: id state_change__node__needs_review, type node, plugin state_change:node__needs_review, empty configuration (e.g. Drupal\system\Entity\Action::create([...])->save()). This mirrors what the module's hook_install does per derivative.

evals.prompt: Create the workbench_moderation_actions bulk action that sets nodes to the 'published' moderation state on this site's Action list. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an 'action' config entity: id state_change__node__published, type node, plugin state_change:node__published, empty configuration, then save.
